# Nexus v1.96.4 Echo update

This Good Enough Nexus compatibility release updates automation for Ebonhold's fully random Echo offerings.

## Changes

- Treats every visible Echo slot as random except for banished choices.
- Freezes one of two simultaneously visible wishlist Echoes before taking the other when Freeze is available.
- Removes the assumption that a selected Saved Build guarantees prior-run Echoes or a particular board slot.
- Falls back to the verified active server slot when the level-80 live loadout mirror is temporarily empty.
- Labels the Echo Journal selector as the Nexus HUD target and shows which HUD calculations it controls.
- Explains the level-80 orb workflow, including when to resave or reload the active Ebonhold Saved Build.
- Warns users to disable Project Ebonhold Enhanced because it conflicts with current loadouts, wishlist creation, and automation.
- Moves the standalone repository to `SchmidtCode/Good-Enough-Nexus` and makes `main` the protected release branch.

The runtime addon, installed folder, slash commands, and SavedVariables remain `Nexus`. Update notices still point to Viscerals' official Better Nexus releases for the eventual 1.20 handoff.

The random-board behavior received a complete live Project Ebonhold run before the release-number update. The exact version-only v1.96.4 commit was validated by the complete offline Lua, Node, static parsing, and packaging suites; it did not receive a separate in-game run.
